objective: Expand longitudinal authority from +/-0.5 toward +/-1 m/s with current sensing, 132 mm geometry, 3.8-4.4 m/s speed target and up to 35 deg/s turns
initial_candidate: Packaged firmware 4995915df52e4977185e2f7e1e4616118576a9883923a7398679edcf6876a49e; change HUP/HDN only, HRTC=.7
comparison_gates: At matched commands, candidate pitch-rate RMS and peak <=1.2*PG+TECS+2 deg/s; preserve quiet recovery; report saturation and power separately. No aggregate score can override a stability/recovery failure.
reporting: Per-case outcomes, median/p90/worst; power is modeled shaft power. Failure screens are operational regression criteria, not calibrated collapse/stall or structural boundaries. Freeze held-out cases before running them.
release: Only proven bounds; do not silently loosen gates after failures. Retain failed candidates and narrow envelope if needed. Dryden is synthetic and canopy collapse is not modeled.
